thinking: User identified that /compact at 60% could lose WAI behavioral rules since the hook exits silently after first wakeup. Two-part fix: (1) Hook now emits a compact ~10 line wai-essentials block on every UserPromptSubmit after protocol_completed=true. (2) CLAUDE.md now has inline Critical Rules section with P1/P2/P3/P10/P11, track requirement, deny rules, and closeout reminder. CLAUDE.md survives compaction by design (CC always loads it). Together these guarantee WAI rules persist through any number of compactions.
